privacy_model: Local dictation without Presspeech-authored analytics or cloud transcription; bundled-library network behavior varies by published version

network_calls.name: macos_first_launch_model_download
network_calls.when: First launch until the model weights are cached locally; again if the local cache fails its integrity check and is re-downloaded; again when the user chooses Reset Speech Model Cache
destination: Hugging Face model-storage and CDN hosts under hf.co
network_calls.purpose: FluidAudio downloads the Parakeet TDT v3 CoreML model weights
network_calls.data_sent: Standard HTTPS request metadata; no dictation audio. macOS 0.3.8 can attach an inherited HF_TOKEN, HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN, or HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN as an Authorization header. Upcoming 0.3.9 removes those credentials from its own process before FluidAudio can read them, so its public model download carries no account credential; this does not alter the user's shell or token store

network_calls.name: windows_first_launch_model_download
network_calls.when: First Windows launch until the automatically selected local model is cached; again after the user selects an uncached model in Settings
destination: Hugging Face model-storage and CDN hosts under hf.co
network_calls.purpose: Download local speech-model weights: multilingual Parakeet TDT v3 when NVIDIA CUDA is usable, or English-only Whisper base.en for the automatic CPU first-run path; other models are user-selectable
network_calls.approximate_size: About 2.5 GB for Parakeet TDT v3 or 141 MiB for Whisper base.en
network_calls.data_sent: HTTPS request metadata, selected public model and revision, and bundled library/runtime versions in User-Agent fields; no dictation audio or transcript. Hugging Face necessarily observes and can count the model fetch itself. Published Windows 0.1.12 does not disable the Hugging Face libraries' default telemetry; those libraries may send library-defined usage telemetry, and Transformers includes a random per-process session identifier in model-request metadata. The exact telemetry event fields are defined by the bundled libraries and are not independently enumerated here. Upcoming Windows 0.1.13 additionally fixes the public huggingface.co endpoint, disables Hugging Face library telemetry, removes inherited User-Agent origin data and implicit authentication, explicitly declines account tokens, and replaces Transformers' random request session ID with the fixed non-unique value telemetry-off. These additional controls are not claimed for published 0.1.12. The opt-out is runtime-checked for the bundled Hugging Face Hub and Transformers libraries; it does not establish that hf-xet 1.6.0 performance telemetry is disabled. Presspeech sets HF_XET_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 for forward compatibility, but the pinned hf-xet version has no verified runtime switch, so no opt-out claim is made for that separate telemetry.

network_calls.name: macos_update_check
network_calls.when: Every 6 hours when automatic update checks are enabled, plus one check shortly after launch
network_calls.purpose: Check whether a newer immutable Presspeech release is available and notify the user
network_calls.data_sent: GET with a fixed User-Agent header, exactly presspeech-update-check; Presspeech adds no version, device, or user identifier and sends no transcript, microphone audio, settings, or usage counts. GitHub can observe the source IP address and request timing as ordinary connection metadata

network_calls.name: windows_update_check
network_calls.when: At most once every 24 hours when automatic checks are enabled, plus manual checks from the tray menu
network_calls.destination: api.github.com/repos/rcourtman/presspeech/releases?per_page=100, followed by bounded numbered pages from that same endpoint only when GitHub reports more than 100 releases
network_calls.purpose: Find a newer complete, immutable windows-vX.Y.Z release and offer it to the user
network_calls.data_sent: GET with a fixed User-Agent header, exactly presspeech-windows-update-check; Presspeech adds no version, device, or user identifier and sends no transcript, microphone audio, settings, or usage counts. GitHub can observe the source IP address and request timing as ordinary connection metadata

network_calls.name: user_triggered_feedback_form
network_calls.when: Only when the user chooses Report a Problem or Suggest an Improvement
network_calls.purpose: Open a focused public GitHub issue form in the default browser
network_calls.data_sent: The app adds no version, device, settings, transcript, diagnostics, or usage data to the fixed URL; the browser and GitHub handle normal request and account metadata

network_calls.name: user_triggered_compatibility_guide
network_calls.when: In macOS 0.3.8, upcoming Windows 0.1.13, or builds containing the new action, and only when the user chooses Test App Compatibility
network_calls.purpose: Open the public privacy-safe repeated target-app test guide in the default browser
network_calls.data_sent: The app adds no version, device, settings, transcript, diagnostics, or usage data to the fixed URL; the browser and destination host handle normal request metadata

network_calls.name: user_triggered_install_or_update
network_calls.when: Only when the user downloads the app directly, installs through Homebrew, or chooses to update through the menu or Homebrew
network_calls.purpose: User-triggered install/update flow: immutable GitHub release download checked against its published SHA-256, a Homebrew metadata refresh followed by the signed macOS archive, or a Windows installer whose immutable release state, published size, and SHA-256 are verified before launch
network_calls.data_sent: Browser or Homebrew request metadata; no dictation audio

local_storage.transcripts: macOS recent transcript history is configurable, stays in memory only, and clears on quit; Windows does not keep an in-app transcript history
local_storage.clipboard: On macOS, pasted transcripts stay on the current pasteboard for automatic or manual paste. macOS 0.3.8 can expose transcript entries to macOS Universal Clipboard. Builds containing local-only transcript clipboard writes prepare every automatic-paste, recovery, recent-transcript and scratchpad copy as current-device-only and add standard transient, auto-generated, and concealed markers asking cooperating clipboard managers not to archive or visibly expose those entries while preserving local Command-V. Optional guarded restoration keeps an eligible complete previous clipboard only in memory; snapshots are limited to 64 MB and 256 representations and are skipped if incomplete, over either limit, or superseded by newer copied content. A restored previous clipboard retains its item representations but is republished current-device-only because the snapshot cannot recover its earlier cross-device scope. macOS Clipboard History in Spotlight on macOS 26 or later, Third-party clipboard managers that ignore those advisory markers, and other local readers remain separate boundaries. On Windows, the transcript remains on the current clipboard until overwritten. Published Windows 0.1.12 writes can enter Windows Clipboard History or Cloud Clipboard. Upcoming 0.1.13 places ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing on every dictation clipboard item before transcript text, instructing Windows not to retain or sync it through those services while preserving Ctrl+V. Presspeech does not provide transcript sync.
